description: This file contains unit tests for the DeepLinkParser module in the OpenClaw project. It verifies the correct parsing and handling of deep link URLs for different scenarios, including agent links, gateway links, and setup codes. The tests cover validation, parsing of fields, and rejection of invalid inputs.

classes.name: DeepLinkParserTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the DeepLinkParser, testing URL parsing, validation, and deep link handling.

methods.name: setupCode
methods.description: Encodes a payload string into a base64 URL-safe string with padding removed.

methods.name: agentAction
methods.description: Creates a DeepLinkRoute.agent with specified parameters for testing deep link URL parsing.
